name: Electron microscope
definition: Microscope that forms an image with a beam of electrons instead of light (scanning or transmission; tabletop models included).
reason: Page must show electron microscopes as a product type (SEM/TEM). Ownable, used and tabletop units; market is a tag. Also NAO FEI page.

name: Scanning probe microscope
definition: Microscope that maps a surface by scanning it with a fine physical probe (atomic force, scanning tunnelling).
reason: Page must show scanning probe or atomic force microscopes as products. Probe, not optics or electrons: its own principle (memo kind axis).

name: Atomic force microscope
reason: Commonest scanning-probe design, made by many makers: non-maker named form of the new kind (as Ritchey-Chretien in DPW1); waits for attestation.

name: Spectrometer
definition: Instrument that splits light from a sample into a spectrum and measures it (UV-Vis, infrared, Raman, emission); a hand spectroscope is this kind.
reason: Key step 23 names the spectroscope a C6 sample instrument. Page must show spectrometers sold as a type. Telescope-only spectroscopes are C6.5.1 parts (S3).

name: Mass spectrometer
definition: Instrument that ionises a sample and sorts the ions by mass to charge to identify its components.
reason: Different principle from the optical spectrometer, sold under its own name. Page must show mass spectrometers as a product type.

name: Chromatograph
definition: Instrument that separates the components of a sample by passing it through a column (gas or liquid chromatography, HPLC).
reason: Separates a sample, the C6.3.2 axis. Page must show chromatographs or HPLC/GC systems as a product type (also Waters page).

name: Elemental analyser
definition: Instrument that measures the elements (carbon, hydrogen, nitrogen, sulphur and others) a sample contains, usually by combustion.
reason: Measures a sample for science (key step 23 note). Page must show elemental analysers as a product type.

name: Glove box
definition: Sealed cabinet with fitted gloves for working on samples in an inert or isolated atmosphere.
reason: Encloses samples, sealed, unlike the airflow cabinets C6.3.2.06/.12/.13. Page must show glove boxes as a product group.

name: Climatic chamber
definition: Cabinet that holds samples at a set temperature and humidity, below or above room temperature, for stability or ageing tests.
reason: Controls humidity and cold, beyond the incubator's warm set point. Page must show climatic cabinets as a laboratory product group.

name: Laboratory stirrer
definition: Device that mixes a liquid sample with a stirring bar or paddle, magnetic or overhead, often with a heating plate.
reason: Stirs inside the vessel; the shaker (C6.3.2.10) moves the vessel. Page must show stirrers as a product type.

name: Laboratory water bath
definition: Heated tank of water that holds sample vessels at a set temperature.
reason: Warms samples in liquid, not air (incubator, oven). Page must show water baths as a product type (also NAO newequipment page).

name: Laboratory circulator (thermostat)
definition: Unit that heats or cools a liquid and pumps it to hold a bath or connected apparatus at a set temperature.
reason: German Thermostat = circulator; pumps temperature-held liquid to apparatus, unlike a bath. Page must show circulators or thermostats as a type.

name: Viscometer
definition: Instrument that measures the viscosity of a liquid sample.
reason: Measures a sample for study (key step 23 note); trade material testers stay C1. Page must show viscometers as a product type.

name: Rheometer
definition: Instrument that measures how a sample flows and deforms under applied stress or strain.
reason: Sold apart from viscometers under its own name. Page must show rheometers as a product type.

name: Microplate reader
definition: Instrument that measures absorbance, fluorescence or luminescence of samples in the wells of a microplate.
reason: Measures samples; generic name used across makers. Page must show microplate readers as a product type.

name: Laboratory thermometer
definition: Thermometer made to read the temperature of a sample, liquid-in-glass or digital probe.
reason: C6.2.1.01 reads air only. Kitchen B5, clinical H2, pool C2 thermometers go by task (key note). Page must show laboratory thermometers.
A barometer is filed by mechanism (memo kind axis); a dial barometer without mercury is the aneroid kind.

name: Cloud sensor
definition: Instrument that detects cloud cover by measuring the infrared temperature of the sky.
reason: Measures sky radiation, the C6.2.4 leaf. Page must show cloud sensors sold as a product type.

name: Sky-quality meter
definition: Instrument that measures the brightness of the night sky.
reason: Measures sky light, the C6.2.4 radiation leaf. Page must show sky-quality meters as a product type.
Step 4 precedes 23: an observatory, backyard or institutional, is a structure entered, filed whole; a dome sold alone is C8 (G2 note).

name: Microscope stage
definition: Stage made to fit a microscope, manual or motorised, that holds and moves the specimen.
reason: Part made for one kind of instrument (S3). Page must show microscope stages sold apart from the microscope.
Motorisation and controller are attributes of the stage (C10); no generic type sold under this name.
Steam sterilisers are the laboratory autoclave; a dry-heat steriliser is a laboratory oven (C6.3.2.04).
Laboratory shaker definition includes rocking motion.
Benches and cabinets that hold several objects are furniture (B1), never parts (S3); not an instrument.

name: Dew shield
definition: Tube fitted to the front of a telescope to keep dew and stray light off the objective.
reason: Part made for telescopes (S3). Page must show dew shields as a product type; dew heaters stay unentered until shown.

name: Telescope focuser
definition: Draw-tube unit fitted to a telescope that moves the eyepiece or camera to focus (Crayford, rack and pinion, motorised).
reason: Part made for telescopes (S3). Page must show focusers sold apart; drive type is an attribute.

name: Molecular model kit
definition: Set of atom and bond pieces for building models of molecules, made to teach chemistry.
reason: S3a teaching set, no experiment programme, so not C6.4.01; key step 23 names science-education kits. Page must show molecular model kits.
